artworks.title: Après la pluie (After the Rain)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint in black-brown on cream laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with precise, detailed linework. It is drawn at street level, looking down a long, narrow street towards a building with a tall spire in the distance. The left side has buildings and people walking with umbrellas, while the right side has more buildings with shadows. In the distance is the silhouette of a church or cathedral on the horizon. The color palette is monochromatic, with sepia or brown tones. The sky has dramatic clouds with swirling lines.

artworks.title: Les Noctambules (The Night Prowlers)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in black on beige laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person holding an umbrella in a dark alley surrounded by many cats. The figure stands in the center of the alley, which is filled with cats. The artwork uses deep, dark tones and textured lines to create a sense of a rainy or gloomy atmosphere. The presence of the umbrella suggests bad weather, and the shadows in the alley add depth to the scene. The setting feels intimate and solitary, with a mysterious vibe due to the heavy use of shadow.

artworks.title: La Ronde de nuit (Night Patrol)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, and roulette (?) in black on beige wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a path leading to a church in the distance. Tall trees line the path, reaching towards the sky with dark and textured brushstrokes. The color palette is muted with deep browns and blacks contrasting against a lighter background, accentuating shapes and silhouettes.

artworks.title: Adresse de Labric
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and aquatint in black on cream laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate (extends beyond sheet on left): 19.8 x 24.5 cm (7 13/16 x 9 5/8 in.)
sheet: 22.1 x 30.6 cm (8 11/16 x 12 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a decorative panel in the upper right, showcasing text and ornamental elements alongside a figure in traditional attire, and larger scenes in the bottom half with multiple objects and figures. The color palette is primarily monochrome with various shades of brown.

artworks.title: Jacques Cazotte's "Le Diable amoureux" (1st vignette)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on thin Japanese paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two central figures. One figure is playing a curved horn instrument. The other figure on the right has animalistic features, potentially resembling a satyr or a mythical creature. The background displays an ornate and chaotic landscape with a swirling sky and hints of a castle or battlements. The drawing is detailed with swirling patterns, creating a dark atmosphere. The style is reminiscent of etching, with deep contrasts and cross-hatching for shading and texture.

artworks.title: Jacques Cazotte's "Le Diable amoureux" (2nd vignette)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on moderately thick Japanese paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 5.1 x 7 cm (2 x 2 3/4 in.)
sheet: 16.5 x 16.8 cm (6 1/2 x 6 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythical seascape. The image shows a mermaid with an upraised arm, sitting on a sea creature. Surrounding her are turbulent waves. Above the mermaid, an angel-like figure with wings floats, holding a scroll or fabric. In the background, there is a castle-like structure on a rocky coast, under a spiked crown sky. A ship sails towards the sunset on the horizon. Decorative skulls and shells are present along the border.

artworks.title: Jacques Cazotte's "Le Diable amoureux" (3rd vignette)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on thin cream wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene framed with ornate decoration. The central part of the drawing depicts a gathering of figures in a historical or fantastical setting. A central figure stands with one arm raised in a gesture. Other figures surround him, in various attitudes. In the background is a guillotine and various objects, indicating a theme of judgment or execution. The top of the drawing is adorned with Baroque-style flourishes and figures, including a cherubic face on the left and a face or mask at the center. The bottom section is embellished with a red emblem. The style of drawing reflects detailed and expressive linework.

artworks.title: Un Thé de Douairières (The Dowagers' Tea Party)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint (dust ground and spirit ground) in black on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image shows a room with three figures. One figure is standing, while the other two are seated. One seated figure is partially visible from behind, and the other is seen in profile in front of a small table. The standing figure is a woman in profile wearing an elaborate gown with styled hair. The room has luxurious furniture like a chair, a table with a teapot, and other objects. The background showcases intricate wall paneling, a decorative fireplace, and artistic embellishments of ethereal figures, cherubs, and floral designs.

artworks.title: I Promessi Sposi (The Betrothed)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint (spirit ground) in black on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a grand room with people engaging in social activities. A man in a formal suit stands in the foreground, holding an object, with a stern expression. Women in elaborate gowns are shown in conversation behind him. The room features ornate architecture, including high ceilings and decorations. The background shows guests under subdued lighting. The margins of the etching include sketches of fantastical figures and natural elements.

artworks.title: Les Adieux (The Parting)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, and aquatint (spirit ground) in black on Japanese paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gothic scene. The central image shows an ornate room where a figure is cradling another figure. The room is dimly lit with shadows on the walls, and a large painting or tapestry is prominent. The top and sides of the drawing are bordered by fantastical elements like mythical creatures and abstract forms, such as figures intertwined with swirling designs.

artworks.title: Une Variété dans l'Amour (A Change of Heart)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint (dust ground), and roulette in black on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in an ornately decorated room. In the center, a man is leaning against a decorative chair. He is wearing a dark suit with a light-colored shirt, and has a mustache and short hair. Beside him, a woman is reclining on a luxurious couch or chaise lounge. She is positioned against the armrest, wearing an elegant dress with styled hair. The room features large leafy plants, patterned drapery, and hanging decorative orbs. The setting is indoors with a tiled floor, surrounded by intricate designs.

artworks.title: Caramba! Fit-elle (Caramba! She Exclaimed)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint (dust ground and spirit ground), and possibly sugar lift in black on Japanese paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing two figures on horseback in a wooded area. The central image depicts an exchange between two riders, one on a light-colored horse and the other on a dark horse, surrounded by trees. The surrounding area features sketches, including a couple in conversation, a lion statue, and an indistinct form. The overall composition suggests a narrative moment captured in a forest setting, with emphasis on the interaction between the equestrians. The detailed line work and shading create depth and texture in the scene.

artworks.title: Le Criard (The Shrieker)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint (dust ground and spirit ground), salt lift, and possibly sugar lift in black on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image is a print that combines detailed etching with a variety of sketch-like illustrations. The main scene at the center of the image portrays a stormy seascape. The perspective is as if the viewer is standing on a wet shoreline looking out at the turbulent sea. Close to us, a figure appears to be running or bracing against the wind. Beyond this, the horizon is low, with crashing waves and indistinct clouds blending into the sky, though a ship is faintly visible. The technique of the brushstrokes and line work in the central section is intricate and dynamic, emphasizing the chaotic movement of the ocean. The image is primarily monochrome, with dark, stormy hues contrasting against light etched surfaces. Surrounding this inset are more artistic sketches: to the left, a depiction of sailors grappling with a boat's mast, while ethereal figures and a bird fill the upper right space. Below, beyond the central scene, lies a calmer shoreline and distant figures. The overall composition mixes detailed etching with softer sketches.

artworks.title: La Blanche Caroline (Pale Caroline)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint (dust ground and spirit ground), and roulette or rocker (along the top margin) in black on Japanese paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a figure near a castle-like structure amid a dark setting. The central image is surrounded by various etched illustrations and decorative elements, including birds and floral motifs, framed within an abstract design. The drawing depicts a castle with a turret, bare trees, and a cloudy night sky. There is a sense of movement from the figure suggesting dynamism in the narrative. The surrounding area has sketches of flora and partially drawn figures, intertwining with the border design.

artworks.title: Ryno et Hermangarde
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, softground etching, salt lift, aquatint (spirit ground) and roulette in black on Japanese paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a person riding a horse in a dynamic landscape. The central illustration shows a person riding a galloping horse across a rugged terrain or shoreline with expressive, swirling strokes. The background is richly textured, with abstract patterns and illustrations, including sketches of figures and a ship mast with birds. The composition conveys a feeling of urgency and dynamism, with swirling lines and contrasting dark and light patches suggesting movement and chaos.

artworks.title: Le Bas-Hamet
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, aquatint (dust ground and spirit ground) in black on Japanese paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a snowy village scene with various sketches around it. In the center, there is a snowy village street with houses and a figure. The sky above is depicted as heavy and dark. Surrounding the central scene are various delicate sketches of figures and forms, adding a dreamlike quality. The margins of the paper are filled with lightly sketched figures, possibly representing imaginative or spiritual elements.

artworks.title: Le Tombeau du Diable (The Devil's Tomb)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint (spirit ground) and roulette (lower right margin, above the girl's head) in black on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image features an engraving depicting two figures, one male and one female, positioned in the center. The male figure is shown kneeling and leaning toward the sitting female figure. The female has long hair drawn back and appears to be dressed in a flowing garment, while the male figure is more difficult to describe due to the darkness surrounding him. No notable facial expression is discernible from the female's face due to the etching's shading. They are enclosed within what seems to be a cavern with rugged walls, and a torch illuminating the space from a sconce on the wall, casting shadows around them. Surrounding this central image is an intricately etched border with mythical and abstract figures, including a creature with a human head and a lion's body and other suggestive forms blending into the design.

artworks.title: Un Grain à Trouville (Squall at Trouville)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a beach scene with a crowd under parasols on the sandy shore. In the background, there are flags on tall poles. The sky above has expressive brushstrokes and swirling clouds. The color palette is sepia tones and black. Details like chairs show the shoreline's edge.

artworks.title: Le retour des artistes (The Return of the Artists)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and roulette in black on thin Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image shows a tree-lined urban street on a rainy day. The trees line the street creating a canopy. Three figures stand on the pavement, two holding umbrellas. In the middle, there is a horse-drawn carriage with people crossing the wet road. The painting style is etching with a sketch-like quality. The color scheme is monochromatic in shades of grey and black, creating a moody atmosphere. The wet street reflects light, adding to the sense of rain, while blurred figures and trees suggest movement in the city.

artworks.title: La Fête nationale au Boulevard Clichy (National Holiday on the Boulevard de Clichy)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, stop-out, foul-bite, and softground etching in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an urban scene. The central image shows a bustling street with a prominent lamp post dividing the scene. The street features figures in Victorian-era attire, a small dog, and buildings draped in flags. The image is surrounded by a border showing scenes of carriages, riders on horseback, and leisure activities. The style of the drawing evokes urban life with social interactions and a festive atmosphere.

artworks.title: L'Hiver à Paris (Winter in Paris)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, spit-bite etching, softground etching, drypoint, and scraping in black on artificial vellum
artworks.description: The image shows a street-level perspective of a bustling urban scene. The horizon is not distinctly visible, and the focus is on the busy street with tall buildings lining it. The art style uses a sketch-like technique with brushstrokes, giving the scene a dynamic quality. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown and beige, with snow on the ground. Figures and dogs are seen on the street, and the scene extends into the distance where the street converges towards a vanishing point. Horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians are visible in the busy city setting.

artworks.title: La Place Pigalle en 1878 (Place Pigalle in 1878)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, and roulette with burnishing in brown-black and brown-red on vellum
artworks.description: The image shows a city square at street level. Buildings and chimneys dominate the horizon against a softly rendered sky. In the center, a horse-drawn carriage moves on the cobblestone street, surrounded by people. Near a building labeled "Tout Paris," individuals are busy with various activities. A group of people is gathered near a fountain-like structure, with two women sharing an umbrella. The color palette is mainly sepia and earthy tones, evoking a vintage atmosphere. The scene is detailed, with additional buildings and people extending into the distance.

artworks.title: Chaumières anglaises (English Cottages)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, sulphur tint, and softground etching in black on beige laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a variety of lines and shapes layered over each other. Dark parallel lines and scattered crosshatchings create an abstract composition. There are dome-like shapes in the upper half of the image, along with lighter fragmented lines suggesting reflections or distant outlines.

artworks.title: La Traversée (The Passage)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, aquatint and stop-out in brown-black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of scenes on a ship. The central panel shows figures on the ship's deck looking out towards the horizon. The sky is cloudy. The left panel shows an ethereal figure in the clouds with a small animal below. The lower panel shows several figures seated closely together, some wrapped in blankets. The drawing presents different activities aboard a ship through small vignettes.
